text:
tara.l: hi all, new hire here. I'm following the onboarding checklist and hit a snag: I don't have Vault access and need to wrap a test secret with KMS for a cross-account demo. who do I ping / what's the exact flow?

ev an.r: welcome! :wave: flow is: request via infra-bot -> include env/resource/reason/duration/target_account if wrapping -> infra reviews -> security does any cross-account approvals -> you'll get a short-lived Vault token or wrapped ciphertext.

leo.m: couple practical notes from last week: 1) we use OIDC SSO to authenticate to Vault, so run `vault login -method=oidc role=redwood-dev` after your SSO session is active, 2) for KMS wrapping include `wrap_key=projects/..../keyRings/..../cryptoKeys/..` in the request.

tara.l: nice, is there a template message I can paste to the bot?

infra-bot: Template: `@infra-bot request type=vault env=staging resource=secret/data/team/<team>/demo reason="<short reason>" duration_hours=4 wrap_key=<kms_path> target_account=acct-12345`. Add `sensitive=true` if you want stricter audit/notifications.

security-bot: Also include `rotation=manual|auto` if you want a rotation policy. Default for service secrets is `auto monthly`. User sessions default to 8h.

tara.l: I need to share a test webhook secret with partner account acct-98765 for a demo. Sending request now.

tara.l: @infra-bot request type=vault env=staging resource=secret/data/team/redwood-inference/demo reason="partner demo" duration_hours=6 wrap_key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/demo/cryptoKeys/wrapKey target_account=acct-98765 rotation=auto

infra-bot: Request queued. Ticket SEC-5408 created. FYI this will set up a KMS-wrapped ciphertext and create a read-only role for the target account. Expect ~45m for cross-account approvals.

leo.m: prod access is more stringent: we require both an eng-security and product owner approval, a revocation runbook, and a justification that includes why the secret can't be scoped to a service role.

ev an.r: emergency access (breakglass) exists but is audited and short-lived. To request breakglass tag `#breakglass` and include a phone number for an oncall approval. That route requires manual 2FA verification.

tara.l: what about rotation best practices? I know CI tokens rotate differently than service keys.

security-bot: Best practices: - CI job tokens should be ephemeral (<24h) and stored in pipeline secret store. - Service keys: rotate monthly and enable auto-rotation if used by long-running services. - KMS master keys: rotate per compliance schedule (we do annual rotated keys with automatic rewrap). - Add `SEC-<ticket>` to PR description when referencing any secret.

leo.m: ops tip: to inspect wrapped payload locally: `gcloud kms decrypt --location=global --keyring=demo --key=wrapKey --ciphertext-file=secret.ct --plaintext-file=secret.txt` (or use AWS KMS equivalent). Don't commit decrypted files.

tara.l: gotcha. who should I escalate to if this stalls?

ev an.r: ping @leo.m and @security-bot with the ticket number, or open an ops request in #release-war-room if it's blocking a demo.

infra-bot: Approval complete for SEC-5408. Token and wrapped ciphertext posted to the staging secret path. Access expires in 6 hours.

tara.l: confirmed I can fetch the wrapped secret via Vault, thanks! added SEC-5408 to the demo PR. :thumbsup:

leo.m: welcome aboard and great question. If you want walkthroughs we do short pairing sessions for new hires, DM me and we can do 15min.

tara.l: will do, thanks everyone!
